LJCMySqlDataAccess.summary: Contains methods to complement a DataColumn object.

ConnectionString.summary: Gets or sets the ConnectionString value.

ConstructorParam.summary: Initializes an object instance with the supplied values.

ExecuteNonQuery.summary: Executes an Insert, Update or Delete statement.

FillDataTable.summary: Executes a Select statement and fills the specified DataTable.

GetDataReader.summary: Executes a Select statement and retrieves the MySqlDataReader object.

GetDataSet.summary: Executes a Select statement and retrieves the DataSet object.

GetDataTable.summary: Executes a Select statement and retrieves the DataTable object.

GetDataTableFromReader.summary: Executes a Select statement and retrieves the DataTable object.

GetProcedureDataTable.summary: Executes a Stored Procedure and retrieves the DataTable object.

GetSchema.summary: Retrieves the DataTable object with schema data.
